_comment: Captured telemetry records (Milestone 5B) — real rows from data/samples/,
converted to the JSON-safe shape src/services/database/telemetry.records.ts
produces. This is what makes projections.ts purity useful rather than merely
true: every projection can be exercised against these with no database, no
connection and no Prisma, exactly as a portal normalizer runs against
src/services/portal/fixtures/.
PROVENANCE. battery and gps are row 2 of telemetry_battery.csv and
telemetry_gps.csv (vehicle TK-51105-02AZ-179386, 2026-06-16). can is row 2 of
telemetry_can.csv (vehicle TK-51105-06DZ-215008, 2026-06-25). The CAN payload
is TRIMMED from its 113 signals to the ones the catalogue reads plus four kept
as evidence; no value was altered and none was invented.
WHAT THE KEPT EVIDENCE SHOWS.
- battery_temp reads 41.05000000000001 — the upstream float artifact that is
why projections round to the precision the source actually carries.
- mfh and soh_1 are stamped 1781850017186, which is 5.7 DAYS older than the
row's own recordedAt. The payload is a last-known-value snapshot, so
recordedAt equals only the freshest signal — which is why every CAN
observation carries its own measuredAt (docs/DATA-IMPORT.md §7).
- soh reads 100 and soh_1 reads 99 in the same row: the two competing CAN
state-of-health signals SAD §19 rejects in favour of battery_telemetry.soh_pct.
- cell_voltage_20 reads 0 V against no_of_cells = 16 — a zero-padded slot
beyond the pack's real cell count, which is why cell_balance reads the
BMS-computed extremes instead of aggregating the numbered slots.
